name: What data and metrics are used to measure the success of an AEO strategy?
description: AEO success is measured by tracking featured snippet impressions, voice search volume, direct answer appearances, organic traffic, and lead conversions.

mainEntity.name: What data and metrics are used to measure the success of an AEO strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measuring AEO success involves tracking key metrics such as featured snippet impressions and clicks, voice search query volume, direct answer appearances, and increases in organic traffic from informational queries. We also monitor branded vs. non-branded search visibility, changes in domain authority, and ultimately, lead generation and client conversions attributed to AEO efforts. These metrics provide a comprehensive view of your firm's increased visibility and impact on client acquisition.
